title: Topic 5: Feelings & States - Writing
description: Handwritten task (Mode B): write on paper and upload a photo.
canDoStatement: Say how you feel; ask others how they feel

writingTask.writingPrompt:
SECOND PAPER TASK. Student writes BY HAND on paper, then
uploads a photo / scan / PDF.

TASK: Write a short note to a friend, by hand.

Instructions shown in app:
  1. Take a piece of paper.
  2. Write a short note to a real friend. Say hello, say how
     you are today (2 feelings), and ask how your friend is.
  3. Sign your name at the end.
  4. Take a photo and upload it.

MODEL (shown in app - scaffold, Topics 1-7):
  Hi Marta!
  How are you?
  I am happy but very tired today.
  My mother is tired too!
  Are you fine?
  - Bia

Minimum requirements:
  - 4 to 5 sentences, handwritten
  - 2 feeling words with I am
  - 1 question to the friend (How are you? / Are you...?)
  - Greeting at the start + your name at the end
